No people, no buildings, no ships, no narrative or historical characters. Medium: an original hand-painted landscape with restrained nineteenth-century oil-painting character adapted to painted pixel-oriented game artwork. Broad readable shapes, deliberate crisp small brush clusters, visible but restrained paint texture. Muted ochre, umber, gray green, slate blue, ivory highlights; soft coherent light. It must remain recognizable as a river landscape at small game texture size. The painted image fills the complete rectangle edge to edge: no frame, no matting, no surrounding wall or studio, no perspective distortion.
